data.one_liner: A drag-and-drop file plugin for Flutter Web applications.
data.what_it_does: It exposes a DropzoneView platform view to handle dragging and dropping files into a Flutter Web app. It provides a controller with methods to retrieve file metadata, byte data, streams, or temporary URLs, and also supports picking files via a browser dialog.
use_when: You are building a Flutter Web application that needs to accept dragged and dropped files.
You need to extract file metadata like name, size, MIME type, or read file contents on the web.
avoid_when: You are targeting non-web platforms where drag-and-drop file handling is required, as it only functions on the web.
You only need drag-and-drop *inside* a Flutter app rather than dropping files *into* it from the OS.
strengths: Seamless integration as a federated plugin that compiles cleanly on cross-platform apps without web-only errors.
Provides a rich controller API to read file data, streams, and manage temporary file URLs.
weaknesses: Web only; it will not function on mobile platforms (returns error text on non-web platforms).
Underlying file references are HTML File API references with inherent browser limitations.
data.setup_notes: Use kIsWeb check when embedding DropzoneView to ensure cross-platform compilation.
data.minimal_example:
Stack(
  children: [
    DropzoneView(
      operation: DragOperation.copy,
      cursor: CursorType.grab,
      onCreated: (DropzoneViewController ctrl) => controller = ctrl,
      onDropFile: (DropzoneFileInterface file) => print('Drop: ${file.webFile}'),
    ),
    Center(child: Text('Drop files here')),
  ],
)
